description:
Discover the massive updates in Suno Studio 2.0, bringing classic music production workflows like MIDI and live audio tracking directly into our powerful AI engine. Join product manager Henry and Luke Conard as they explore Studio Chat, advanced stem splitting, and custom plugin creation.

Watch the full Studio 2.0 series here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLcGl48v5p95s

Timestamps:
00:00 - Welcome to Suno Studio 2.0
01:13 - Meet Studio Chat
02:55 - MIDI capabilities and musical typing
06:29 - Tracking live audio and latency calibration
08:07 - AI audio conversion and covering
09:03 - Upgrading older projects to 2.0
09:54 - Advanced stem splitter
11:03 - Removing effects for dry signals
11:46 - Built-in audio effects and signal chains
16:08 - Creating custom plugins with AI
19:51 - Quality of life updates and keyboard shortcuts
21:13 - Outro

Hosted by Henry & Luke Conard

#SunoStudio #SunoV2 #MusicProduction #AI #DAW

comments.text:
Although it's a great idea and a wonderful evolution, I'd have to agree with one or two of the people who've commented below. I was hoping that, either before or along with this, you'd actually address some of the fundamentals that need to be taken care of. There are some issues that persist. Example:
- Stem bleed
- Excessive compression
- Change in audio quality and degradation when you're doing a cover eg. artefacts, lyrics generation loss
- more accents, voices, nuances in vocals
- attention to some acoustic instruments that still sound quite synthetic
- If you're doing an inspiration track from more than two tracks, there is frequently degradation, less prompt adherence and an increased number of bugs. Yes, I do report every single one of them. Yes, they do end up costing credits. :) 
There are quite a few things I'm hoping you are addressing, just as you addressed Studio 2. Great job on it, and I look forward to Suno improving some of those fundamentals. Been with you for years, so I know you've come a long way. Might I suggest refocusing and innovating at the same time, instead of just innovating. 💯👍

comments.text:
This video introduces Suno Studio 2.0, a massive update to their music production platform designed to blend traditional DAW workflows with advanced AI technology. Here is a summary of the key features and improvements discussed:

Studio Chat (01:13): A new AI assistant integrated directly into your project. It understands the state of your session and can help with tasks like renaming tracks, color-coding, or creating new musical elements through natural language commands.
MIDI Capabilities (02:55): Studio 2.0 now fully supports MIDI input via external keyboards or computer "musical typing," allowing for precise control over notes, chords, and voicings.
Live Audio Tracking (06:29): New tools include latency calibration and a count-in pre-roll, making it easier to record live vocals or instruments directly onto the timeline.
Advanced Stem Splitting (09:54): An improved stem splitter allows users to isolate specific instruments with higher fidelity, and a "remove effects" feature helps retrieve dry signals from processed audio (11:03).
Built-in Audio Effects (11:46): The update introduces a robust suite of classic production effects, including reverb, delay, distortion, EQ, and side-chain compression, which can be automated over time.
Custom Plugin Creation (16:08): A standout feature allowing users to use natural language to generate custom plugins. The hosts demonstrate this by creating "Rotor Glow," a specialized tremolo/rotary speaker effect.
Quality of Life (19:51): The engine has been optimized for a more responsive timeline and includes intuitive keyboard shortcuts to switch between device views, piano rolls, and library panels.
